# `morphir kb intent release`

- **Usage:** `morphir kb intent release [FLAGS] [ID]`

Mark an intent Released, linking the capability it produced

## Arguments
- **`[ID]`** — Intent id or slug

## Flags
- **`--kb <PATH>`** — Path to the knowledge base root (the directory holding bundles/). Auto-detected when omitted
- **`--json`** — Emit JSON instead of text, for chaining and for agent consumption
- **`--capability <CAPABILITY>`** — Capability this produced, as bundle-label:/path.md
- **`--artifact <ARTIFACT>…`** — Package URL of a shipped artifact (repeatable)
- **`--date <DATE>`** — Override today's date (YYYY-MM-DD)
